sehemu: Part II: Consolidated Fund and Finances of the United Republic
jina: Procedure for authorising expenditure before Appropriation Act takes effect
maudhui: (1) Parliament may enact a law providing for authorization of expenditure from the Consolidated Fund in accordance with the procedure prescribed in subarticle (2) of this Article. (2) Where a financial year has commenced and the Appropriation Act relating to that year has not come into operation, the President may authorize the issue of money from the Consolidated Fund for the purpose of meeting expenditure necessary for carrying on the services of the Government until the expiry of four months from the beginning of the financial year or until the Appropriation Act comes into operation, whichever is the earlier.
